title: A Bulow-Klemperer Theorem for Bundling and Improved Approximation Bounds for Simple Auctions
abstract: arXiv:2610.24973v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study simple auctions for one additive bidder whose values for $m$ items are independent. Write $\mathrm{REV}$ for the optimal revenue, $\mathrm{SREV}$ and $\mathrm{BREV}$ for the optimal revenues from separate selling and grand bundling, and $\mathrm{BSPA}_2$ for the grand-bundle second-price revenue with two independent bidders.   For independent regular items, we prove $\mathrm{REV} \le \mathrm{BSPA}_2 \le 2\,\mathrm{BREV}$. Thus, one additional bidder lets a reserve-free second-price auction for the grand bundle match the optimal revenue from one bidder, regardless of the number of items. This gives a Bulow-Klemperer theorem for bundling and resolves an open question of Beyhaghi, Cai, Feng, Li, and Weinberg (EC 2025) on whether constant competition suffices for bundling. translated_title: 捆绑销售的Bulow-Klemperer定理及简单拍卖的改进近似界
translated_abstract: 我们研究单个加性估值竞拍者的简单拍卖问题，其中竞拍者对 $m$ 件物品的估值相互独立。记 $\mathrm{REV}$ 为最优收益，$\mathrm{SREV}$ 和 $\mathrm{BREV}$ 分别为分开销售和整体捆绑销售的最优收益，$\mathrm{BSPA}_2$ 为两个独立竞拍者对整体捆绑进行二价拍卖（无保留价）的收益。对于独立的正则分布物品，我们证明 $\mathrm{REV} \le \mathrm{BSPA}_2 \le 2\,\mathrm{BREV}$。因此，只需增加一个竞拍者，对整体捆绑的无保留价二价拍卖即可匹配单个竞拍者情形下的最优收益，且与物品数量无关。这给出了捆绑销售版本的Bulow-Klemperer定理，并解决了Beyhaghi、Cai、Feng、Li和Weinberg（EC 2025）提出的关于常数竞争是否足以支撑捆绑销售的开放性问题。同时，因子2的捆绑近似界也是紧的。对于一般独立分布物品，我们证明 $\mathrm{REV} \le \mathrm{SREV} + \frac{\pi^2}{6}\cdots$
tldr: 本文证明了捆绑销售版的Bulow-Klemperer定理：在正则独立物品下，仅需增加一个竞拍者，无保留价的整体捆绑二价拍卖即可达到单个竞拍者的最优收益，并给出紧的因子2捆绑近似界，解决了EC 2025的一个开放问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proves a Bulow-Klemperer theorem for bundling—with regular independent items, one extra bidder makes a reserve-free second-price auction on the grand bundle match the single-bidder optimal revenue—and establishes a tight factor-2 bundling approximation bound, resolving an open question from EC 2025.
